GPS positions of the Mt Wilhelm ant bait transects

png_ants_sites.Rd

Real field coordinates for the bait transects behind tidydiversity::png_ants. The published data give a GPS position and elevation for every bait; this table averages them to one point per elevation band and transect (two transects per band, eight bands from 200 to 3700 m). Use it to map the study sites or to join coordinates onto tidydiversity::png_ants by site. geo_example_sites() returns the band centroids (mean of the two transects).

Usage

png_ants_sites

Format

A tibble with 16 rows and 7 columns:

site

Elevation band code, as in png_ants ("MW0200").

transect

Transect number within the band (1 or 2).

elevation_band

Nominal elevation band in metres.

elevation

Mean GPS elevation of the baits on the transect, in metres.

lon, lat

Mean WGS84 longitude and latitude of the baits.

baits

Number of bait positions averaged.

Source

Mottl, O., Moses, J. and Klimes, P. (2023). Data and code for "Nutrient use by tropical ant communities varies among three extensive elevational gradients: a cross-continental comparison". Zenodo, open licence. doi:10.5281/zenodo.8191946 . Built by data-raw/png_ants_sites.R in the package source.

References

Moses, J., Peters, M. K., Tiede, Y., Mottl, O., Donoso, D. A., Farwig, N., Fayle, T. M., Novotny, V., Sanders, N. J. and Klimes, P. (2023). Nutrient use by tropical ant communities varies among three extensive elevational gradients: a cross-continental comparison. Global Ecology and Biogeography, 32, 2212-2229. doi:10.1111/geb.13757
